title: Machine learning builds a ten-gene tyrosine metabolism signature in low-grade astrocytoma
summary: From single-cell data and WGCNA hub genes, 101 machine learning algorithm combinations were evaluated and a Lasso + CoxBoost ten-gene risk model was chosen. High risk scores predicted worse 5-year overall survival, with AUC 0.80 in REMBRANDT and 0.73 in CGGA. High-risk tumours showed interferon-gamma response and EMT pathway activity and more M2 macrophage and mast cell infiltration; RAB3C knockdown in MOG-G-UVW cells increased migration, invasion and proliferation. The cohorts are public retrospective datasets and the immune findings are inferred by deconvolution.
ai_technology: Lasso + CoxBoost chosen from 101 machine learning algorithm combinations for a ten-gene prognostic signature

evidence.tested: Two external public cohorts (REMBRANDT, CGGA) plus in vitro RAB3C knockdown assays.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective public data; moderate AUCs; immune interpretations are computational; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning combinations were screened to select the genes and model for the risk score.
